Figure 2. Boundary of the aspernidine A biosynthesis gene
cluster. (A) Organization of genes surrounding the PKS pkfA
involved in aspernidine A biosynthesis in A. nidulans. Black
open reading frames (ORFs) are genes involved in aspernidine A
biosynthesis, while gray ORFs are genes not involved in asper-
nidine A biosynthesis. (B) HPLC profile of extracts of strains in
the cluster as detected by UV absorption at 254 nm. Numbers on
peaks correspond to the compounds shown in Figure 1B.
